Full Stack Developer

Tailspin Toys · Denver, CO · Hybrid

About the job

Tailspin Toys sells toys online and in 40 stores. The commerce team builds the storefront and checkout, and this year that means getting ready for the holidays.

What you'll do:

  • Build storefront and checkout features in React and Node.js
  • Make the busiest pages faster
  • Help the store staff tools team when the holidays are over
    • Inventory lookups
    • Gift card tools

Requirements:

  • React and a server-side language
  • SQL
  • 1 or more years building web apps

Pay: $85,000 - $105,000 per year
